Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a part, part A, that was stocked at the test location before this release was installed and whose number and description nobody has changed since.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).

Setup

  1. Find parts from before this release: On the Inventory list, parts that came with this site's data and were never changed have no clock icon at the left of their row; for example 3030 Long Stroke Brake Chamber (W3030LS), which has stock and Min 10 and Max 50, and 3030 Standard Brake Chamber, 13.25" Rod (W3030T). Use W3030LS as part A.
